markers.cm: 01_1 · Here's the question we discussed in class.
01_2 · Why does Romeo call Juliet the sun?
02_1 · Romeo sees a light in Juliet's window.
02_2 · Then, in one line, he decides what it is.
03_1 · He doesn't say Juliet is like the sun.
03_2 · He says she is the sun. That's a metaphor.
04_2 · Romeo calls it envious, as if it had feelings.
